_help: Everything on the website comes from this file. Edit it, then run `node build.mjs` (or push: GitHub Pages rebuilds the site). Empty links are left out. Fields marked TODO are placeholders and are hidden until you fill them in. For a release player, paste a Spotify, YouTube, SoundCloud or Apple Music share link (or a Bandcamp EmbeddedPlayer link) into embed. The statement, focus, marquee and contact heading are the large lines of text on the home page.

promptmidi.name: PromptMIDI
promptmidi.tagline: Describe the music in words. Get multi-track MIDI.
promptmidi.summary: A VST3 instrument plug-in (with AU on macOS and a standalone app) with a prompt window: type "Generate me a fantasy orchestral midi" or "Make me a soft piano midi", press Generate, and drag the result into your DAW.
promptmidi.statement: Type what you want to hear. PromptMIDI writes it as multi-track MIDI, from orchestral cues to soft piano, jazz and lo-fi, and checks every take against what you asked for.

downloads.label: macOS
downloads.detail: Installer · VST3, AU and standalone app (Universal)

promptmidi.install: Run the installer, tick what you want (the VST3 plug-in, the Audio Unit on macOS, the standalone app, the ReadMe) and choose where each one goes. Everything PromptMIDI needs comes with it. On Linux, unpack the download and run ./install.sh. Then rescan plug-ins in your DAW.
promptmidi.updates: When a new version is out, PromptMIDI tells you inside its window, with a button that downloads the new installer.
promptmidi.unsigned: The installers aren't code-signed yet. On Windows, if SmartScreen appears, click More info, then Run anyway. On macOS, if the package won't open, go to System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click Open Anyway.

features.title: Words in, MIDI out
features.text: Genre, mood, instruments, key, tempo, length and meter in plain English. Offline and instant, or planned by Claude AI with your own API key.

features.title: It does what you asked
features.text: Every prompt becomes a checklist: only piano, a jazz trio, the sax takes the melody, no drums, D minor, 30 seconds. Every draft is checked against it.

features.title: New music every time
features.text: Themes, rhythm and harmony come from statistics learned from 28,000 pieces, never from stored melodies, and every tune is checked to be original.

features.title: Orchestral cues
features.text: Two-to-four-minute game and film cues with an intro, themes, development, a build, a climax and loop points, for a full orchestra in score order.

features.title: A DAW-style editor
features.text: Scroll and zoom through the piece, edit notes with undo, keep every take, save presets, import MIDI files, and hear it all through real instrument samples.

features.title: Straight into your DAW
features.text: Drag the whole piece or one track onto your timeline, or export a .mid with named tracks, markers and keyswitch or UACC articulations.

steps.title: Describe it
steps.text: Type what you want to hear, pick an example, or choose the instruments yourself.

steps.title: Shape it
steps.text: Change key, tempo, length and instruments; press Variation for a new take; edit any note.

steps.title: Drag it out
steps.text: Drop the MIDI on your DAW's timeline, one track or all of them, and play it with your own sounds.

promptmidi.requirements: Windows 10 or later, macOS 11 or later (Apple silicon and Intel), or Linux (x86-64). Any VST3 host; AU hosts on macOS. Claude AI mode needs an Anthropic API key.

faq.a: Yes. Claude AI mode is optional and uses your own Anthropic API key, billed to your account.
No. It stores only statistics (how melodies move, common rhythms and chord progressions), never a melody or a piece, and every generated tune is checked against fingerprints of its reference corpus.

PromptMIDI checks for new versions when you open it and says "An update is available" at the top of its window. Click Download, run the new installer, and it replaces the old version; your settings and presets stay.

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work with?
faq.a: Any DAW that loads VST3 (or AU on macOS): Ableton Live, Logic, FL Studio, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper, Bitwig and more. Drag and drop works everywhere.

faq.q: Can I hear the result before I export it?
faq.a: Yes: the preview plays the piece through real instrument samples inside the plug-in. It stays silent while your DAW plays, so after you drag the MIDI out you only hear your own track.
